title: Adjunct Instructor - Economics - John Chambers College of Business and Economics
description:
The Department of Economics ( 
https://business.wvu.edu/academics/economics-department/economics
) at West Virginia University invites applications for part-time
adjunct positions. Potential areas of need include undergraduate
and graduate courses in any fields of Economics.

The successful candidate will be responsible for in-person and/or
online courses for the undergraduate or graduate programs in the
Chambers College of Business and Economics.

Applications will be accepted throughout the year and will be
considered as openings arise. Salary is established on a per-course
basis.

Qualifications :

Master's degree in Economics or equivalent, is required.
Individuals with a doctoral degree are eligible to teach graduate
or undergraduate courses; individuals with only a master's degree
are eligible to teach undergraduate courses.

Please submit via PDF file (a) a letter of application summarizing
your teaching qualifications, (b) your curriculum vitae, and (c)
contact information for two individuals who can provide letters of
recommendation.
